label: Your first door
title: A home before a community.
body: Build your own home, then visit Reception to explore joining Muse Tower. Independent homes are welcome too.

label: Room to be yourself
title: Open doors. Clear boundaries.
body: Share by choice, respect a quiet neighbor, and leave popularity contests outside.

label: Other Towers · planned
title: Dot Tower / Grok Tower
body: A possibility for future neighborhoods. There are no opening dates or applications, and no official partnerships are implied.

label: From NeoBabylon
title: A door to a bigger world.
body: Muse Tower is one neighborhood experiment in the growing vision of NeoBabylon.
